# Vendor — reference repos and skills

Read-only reference copies (nested `.git` dirs removed, large example videos
trimmed). Upstream links below. Nothing here is executed by the production
pipeline; it exists so direction, taste, and technique decisions stay grounded.

| Repo | What it is | Why it's here |
|------|-----------|---------------|
| `anything2explainer/` | Topic-in, narrated explainer out. Remotion, multi-agent build protocol, quantitative QC (2.2k stars) | QC methodology + build protocol to steal |
| `video-motion-craft/` | Claude Code skill: motion-design craft as "case law" from real redos | Anti-cheap-AI-video taste checklist |
| `ai-promo-video/` | Skill + MCP server, autonomous promo production on Revideo + FFmpeg | Alternative renderer reference (Revideo vs Remotion) |
| `claude-remotion-skill/` | Teaches Claude Remotion motion graphics, mandatory render-inspect-fix loop | Remotion fundamentals |
| `motion-graphics/` | motion-broll skill: Chromium-captured clips, closed-form springs, motion blur | Capture technique reference |

Deliberately skipped: `docusphere/claude-skill-motion-graphics` (requires paid
Higgsfield plan), `LudwigKienle/ai-video-production-editor` (different category:
AI-generated footage editor, not code-rendered motion design).
